integrity: The combinatorial theorem and counts are based on an unrestricted gap proof. Reproducible finite verification is furnished separately and is not represented as independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Minimum-size forts of C_n^2 with n at least 6; not all inclusion-minimal forts, not arbitrary powers or unlabeled orbit counts. Numerical failed-zero-forcing corollary may already follow from earlier circulant results and is not separately claimed original. Potential priority overlap with an inaccessible 2025 circulant failed-zero-forcing paper is disclosed. Finite checks cannot establish the infinite theorem; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Minimum forts of squared cycles: a cyclic-gap classification and exact enumeration
